primarySources.title: CDC Yellow Book 2026: Motion Sickness
primarySources.publisher: CDC; chapter author John F. Golding
primarySources.boundedTakeaway: Sensitivity differs between people. Sensory conflict is an accepted explanatory theory, not a complete diagnosis of every player's symptoms.
primarySources.authoringLimit: At most two brief sentences of general mechanism. No medication recommendations, acclimatisation challenge, treatment promise or diagnosis. A game-design video cannot establish an individual's health outcome.

primarySources.title: Xbox Accessibility Guideline 117: Visual distractions and motion settings
primarySources.boundedTakeaway: Provide player adjustment of camera movement and secondary effects, including bob and shake. This is a developer accessibility guideline, not evidence that a particular recording or option cures nausea.
primarySources.scope: Camera input versus added movement, clear separate controls and player choice; do not repeat the existing FOV visibility lecture.

primarySources.title: PowerWash Simulator developer FAQ
primarySources.author: FuturWob [developer]
primarySources.boundedTakeaway: Aim Mode fixes the view while the washer moves separately. The developer describes optional persistent crosshair, FOV and sensitivity settings and explicitly recognises individual differences.
primarySources.footageNeed: Observe actual fixed-background cleaning and view rotation separately before writing the corresponding narration. Do not infer settings from a visually still shot alone.
primarySources.usage: Developer permits gameplay streams/videos and monetisation; this does not automatically clear every third-party recording or licensed DLC asset. Use original-game official footage or separately authorised recordings; retain final public-rights review pending.

primarySources.title: Sea of Thieves support: Disabling certain visual effects
primarySources.boundedTakeaway: The support page documents a screen-shake disable setting. It does not say that all boat motion or discomfort is removed.
primarySources.candidateStatus: Not selected. Current Microsoft Game Content Usage Rules require a publicly discoverable notice and restrict service-sale context; resolve applicable rights before use. Do not silently assume internal-only credits satisfy that notice.

primarySources.title: Devolver Digital gameplay video permission
primarySources.boundedTakeaway: Publisher allows posting and monetising gameplay videos. Selected recording is official publisher origin; separate third-party press recording not cleared.
